name: Catnap

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Up to three visible willing creatures fall Unconscious. Damage or an action to wake one ends its effect. Ten uninterrupted minutes grants a Short Rest; a beneficiary cannot benefit again before a Long Rest. Add one target per slot above 3.
